title: Figure 4: Details of the PTRE Engine; Figure 5: Combustion Turbo-Ramjet – cutaway diagrams
description: Figure 4 is a 3D cutaway drawing of a positron turbojet/ramjet engine with labels including "Positron Trap," "Electric Motor Driven Compressor," "Concentric Annular Tungsten Heating Surfaces," "Positron Conversion Chamber," "Intake Airflow" and "Exhaust Airflow." Figure 5 is a cross-section schematic of a conventional combustion turbo-ramjet with labels for the turbojet compressor, combustion chamber, ramjet fuel injectors, turbine, ramjet combustion chamber and nozzle. Both are credited "courtesy Positronics Research LLC."
